The issuer shows strong profitability (EBIT is ~46% of revenue) and solid capitalization (shareholders’ equity is ~60% of total assets, with liabilities covering ~40%), indicating good balance-sheet resilience. Liquidity is adequate but not robust (current ratio 1.28), which tempers the rating from the highest bands. Overall, the fundamentals align best with an upper-single-A credit profile.  

DECISION: A
